name: Indian chartered accountant (CA) firms
icp: CA firms in India with roughly 5-60 staff handling GST, income tax and audit work for SME clients. Partner-led decisions.

pains.pain: GST reconciliation (GSTR-2B vs purchase register) done manually in Excel every month
pains.solution: Reconciliation pipeline that matches invoices, flags mismatches and drafts vendor follow-up emails
pains.evidence_to_look_for: GST services listed, many SME clients, hiring article assistants or accountants

pains.pain: Chasing clients for documents during filing season
pains.solution: WhatsApp/email document collection assistant that tracks what is pending per client and sends reminders
pains.evidence_to_look_for: ITR/GST filing services, large client base

pains.pain: Reading GST/income-tax notices and drafting replies
pains.solution: Notice reader that summarizes the notice, pulls relevant client data and drafts a first reply for the CA to edit

offer: A 3-week pilot automating GST reconciliation or document collection for one team
guarantee: If it doesn't save the team at least 15 hours a month by day 30, no monthly fee
mystery_shop: Email asking about GST filing services for a small business and note response time and process
tone: Professional, respectful (address as CA <name> where known), specific to GST/ITR workflows.
language_notes: WhatsApp message only for after first contact.
